summary: Iteration 2 PASS. Backend 24/24 pytest green (12 pre-existing + 12 new covering operator persistence on POST/PATCH/DELETE, Z-suffixed UTC timestamps on tires.created_at/updated_at and movements.timestamp, and sanity on brands/validation). Frontend end-to-end passed on mobile viewport 390x844: fresh storage shows WelcomeScreen with short-name validation; valid name (TEST_Mario_UI) persists to localStorage key gommagest.operator.name and reveals Dashboard; reload bypasses welcome; Cambia opens change modal and updates operator everywhere (TEST_Luigi_UI). formatSize autoformats '165 55 14' => '165/55 R14', '1655514' => '165/55 R14', '165 55 14 91V' => '165/55 R14 91V'. AddTireModal from iteration 1 is now fully usable: all fields visible, Michelin/Estive selected, submit created a tire and movement row shows operator TEST_Mario_UI in cronologia. Qty +/- and delete record the current operator (confirmed via remote PATCH + polling). Real-time sync: a direct PATCH /quantity (simulated 'other device') was reflected in the dashboard stats and cronologia within ~6s via refetchInterval:4000 (dashboard Totale gomme bumped and new 'Aggiunta ... TEST_Remote +1 Tot:3' row appeared). Timestamps rendered with it-IT local time correctly (container TZ is UTC: shown 18:47 matched new Date(Z).toLocaleTimeString).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py utcnow_iso() correctly emits ms-precision ISO with Z suffix for both Tire and Movement default timestamps.
operator_context.tsx: WelcomeScreen gates children until operator is loaded; storage key 'gommagest.operator.name' persisted (verified value: '\"TEST_Mario_UI\"').
query-client.ts + screens: refetchInterval:4000 + staleTime:2000 + refetchOnWindowFocus deliver the required real-time behavior without websockets.
format.ts handles sparse digits and trailing load/speed suffix; verified for the three required inputs.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_-prefixed tires (TEST_205/55 R16 91V, TEST_215/60 R17) and the UI-created '165/55 R14 91V Michelin Estive' via DELETE with ?operator=TEST_cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 iteration-2 features verified: (1) formatSize autofill, (2) operator welcome+persistence+Cambia modal, (3) Z-suffixed UTC timestamps rendered via Date().toLocaleTimeString('it-IT'), (4) 4s polling cross-tab sync. If you re-run UI tests, clear localStorage first to see WelcomeScreen; otherwise the saved name auto-loads. Backend pytest can be run with: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no issues found this iteration. Iteration 1's AddTireModal rendering bug is resolved; the modal is now fully interactive on 390x844 web preview.
